Free.Answer: Yes. Bondery is free with all the core features. A premium version exists for additional features, but the core personal PRM functionality will remain free forever.
Free.Question: Is Bondery free to use?

Private.Answer: Bondery is privacy-first and open source. Your relationship data is handled with a focus on user control and transparency. We will never sell your data or use it for advertising.
Private.Question: Is my data private in Bondery?

SelfHost.Answer: Yes. Bondery is open source and ships a Docker Compose stack for self-hosting. See the self-hosting guide in the docs.
SelfHost.Question: Can I self-host Bondery?

WhatIs.Answer: Bondery is an open-source personal CRM (=PRM) that helps you track relationships, remember key details, and stay connected with your network.
